Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Trailer Sets Netflix Release Date for London-Bound Chapter

03 Nov 2026, 09:51 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: www.comingsoon.net

2 min read

Key takeawaysNetflix has released a new date-announcement trailer for the second season of the acclaimed animated series Blue Eye Samurai, confirming that the next chapter will premiere on January 19, 2027. The upcoming season will consist of six episodes.

Netflix Announces Return of Emmy-Winning Series

Netflix has released a new date-announcement trailer for the second season of the acclaimed animated series *Blue Eye Samurai*, confirming that the next chapter will premiere on January 19, 2027. The upcoming season will consist of six episodes.

The Emmy-winning show follows the central journey of Mizu, whose narrative expands internationally in the upcoming episodes.

What to Expect in Season 2

According to the official logline provided with the announcement, the second season continues Mizu's quest, taking her story to London. The plot description indicates that Mizu will encounter new allies, familiar enemies, and internal challenges. Meanwhile, back in Japan, characters Akemi and Taigen navigate Edo Castle under a new and dangerous Shogun, while Ringo searches for a new purpose.

The newly released trailer features dialogue highlighting Mizu's ongoing revenge mission. When inquiring about her remaining targets, an unnamed character reveals they are located in London, setting the stage for the narrative shift.

Cast and Creative Team

  • Returning Voice Cast: Maya Erskine as Mizu, Brenda Song as Akemi, Darren Barnet as Taigen, and Masi Oka as Ringo.
  • New Additions: Jonathan Pryce as Old Violet, Joel Kim Booster as Priest Ando, and Sherry Cola as Kuma.
  • Creators: Amber Noizumi and Michael Green, who serve as writers and executive producers.
  • Production: Jane Wu as supervising director and producer, with animation by Blue Spirit.

Practical Implications and Verification

Fans looking forward to the continuation of *Blue Eye Samurai* can watch the official date-announcement trailer directly on Netflix's official channels or trusted entertainment news platforms. Viewers are advised to check official Netflix announcements and streaming pages for any future updates regarding the release schedule.
